display.entryTitle: Monument Valley Hot Air Balloons Mickey

description: Flying over Monument Valley in Soarin' Around the World, three hot air balloons drift into line and form a Hidden Mickey for a moment.

whereToLook.scene: The Monument Valley segment of Soarin' Around the World
whereToLook.exactSpot: The hot air balloons. Three of them line up as a head and ears.

bestTip: Watch the balloons as a group rather than following one.
